scope: Rules fixed before inspecting the completed capacity-study results.
primary_comparison: For each task/seed, pairs must have both validation NMSE <= 0.01 and maximum/minimum validation NMSE <= 1.25. Choose the pair minimizing maximum validation NMSE; then log-ratio gap; then IDs. Test/OOD values and graph length are not used to select these accuracy-matched pairs.
ceiling_selection: Within each method/task/seed, choose smallest dependency-valid expanded-CSE graph satisfying the validation NMSE ceiling; ties use validation NMSE and ID.
reporting: Report all candidate results and unpaired cases; report test NMSE, R2, raw/expanded/CSE sizes jointly. No significance claim based on treating seeds as independent equations.
